searchText: <@211091239112671234> - any tips on using snap-test, like where am I going wrong here? ``` geth init --datadir ./geth geth-genesis.json geth --datadir ./geth export chain.rlp devp2p rlpx snap-test "enode://blah-blah-besu" chain.rlp geth-genesis.json ``` yields: `block at index 0 has wrong number 0` I did notice this during export, but wasn't sure it was a problem since it was just a snapshot warning: `WARN [10-02|19:55:10.129] Failed to load snapshot err="missing or corrupted snapshot"` Your second command there is wonky. Directly after init a new genesis, you ask it to export it's chain?? Should be `geth --datadir ./geth import chain.rlp` And the import will exit, so you need to end it with e.g `geth --datadir ./geth --nodiscover` ok, so I need to full sync geth, dump the full chain data to a file, and then feed that back to snap-test?

<@211091239112671234> - any tips on using snap-test, like where am I going wrong here?

```
geth init --datadir ./geth geth-genesis.json
geth --datadir ./geth export chain.rlp
devp2p rlpx snap-test "enode://blah-blah-besu" chain.rlp geth-genesis.json
```

yields: `block at index 0 has wrong number 0`

excerpts.author: suburbandad_
excerpts.content:
I did notice this during export, but wasn't sure it was a problem since it was just a snapshot warning:
`WARN [10-02|19:55:10.129] Failed to load snapshot                  err="missing or corrupted snapshot"`

excerpts.author: holiman
excerpts.content: Your second command there is wonky. Directly after init a new genesis, you ask it to export it's chain?? Should be `geth --datadir ./geth import chain.rlp`

excerpts.author: holiman
excerpts.content: And the import will exit, so you need to end it with e.g `geth --datadir ./geth --nodiscover`
